main_body: A chair seen from the side (facing east/west): a tall backrest column on the right and an L-shaped seat profile; the seat is only a thin edge, with a short front leg stub below.
top_band: none. At x=7 the seat shows only a dark outline at row 9, then rows 10-11 of mid-tone, a 1-row light edge at row 12 and a dark row 13. That is a 2-row edge, not a top surface.
evidence: The chair is a side profile like the red 'side elevation chair' in the guide. The backrest is a tall vertical slab and the seat is a 2-row strip (rows 10-11) with a light edge line at row 12, so no horizontal seat surface can be read from above. The seat is not a 3/4 top. The legs are a thin dark stub. Fails as a side elevation with a thin seat.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours, against 38-40 for the references. It is smaller than one tile, so there is no per-tile median. The backrest and seat are large flat areas of one tone with no grain, dots or highlights. The outline mixes dark brown tints with near-black (47% neutral) at the bottom and leg. Shading is shallow, about 4 steps against 5-6 in the references. It reads thinner and flatter than the references.
